title: Evaluation-transpose comparison for derived ringed-topos pullback
statement: Let $X,Y$ be small ringed-site presentations with commutative structure sheaves, ordinary unbounded module derived categories, and their fixed closed derived tensor structures and signed K-flat representative models [def-sfb-ringed-derived-comparison-data]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a ringed-topos morphism and let $l$ be normalized adjoint-lift data for $f$ [def-sf-ringed-derived-adjoint-lift-data]. Write $L=l_L:D(Y)\to D(X)$ and $H_Z(P,Q)=R\mathcal Hom_Z(P,Q)$ for the existing derived internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. Restrict the fixed tensor representative comparison of each site to flat-term K-flat representatives; this is the tensor model used below. Write $t_{A,B}:L(A\otimes_Y^{\mathbf L} B)\xrightarrow{\sim}LA\otimes_X^{\mathbf L}LB$ for the canonical tensor comparison determined by these models, and $\mu_{A,B}=t_{A,B}^{-1}$. For arbitrary $P,Q\in D(Y)$ define the canonical pullback Hom comparison by the right-tensor adjunction transpose, $$\beta^f_{P,Q}=\operatorname{transpose}_X\!\left(L(\operatorname{ev}^Y_{P,Q})\circ\mu_{H_Y(P,Q),P}\right):LH_Y(P,Q)\longrightarrow H_X(LP,LQ).$$ Here $\operatorname{ev}^Y_{P,Q}:H_Y(P,Q)\otimes_Y^{\mathbf L}P\to Q$ is the counit of the fixed closed structure. This defines the map and its tensorator and model, without asserting naturality or invertibility of $\beta$.

lean.statement:
def ringedPullbackHomComparison {X Y : Site.{u, w}} {f : Morphism X Y}
    (l : AdjointLift f) (P Q : Y.D) :
    l.edge.left.obj ((pullbackHomFunctor Y).obj (op P, Q)) ⟶
      (pullbackHomFunctor X).obj (op (l.edge.left.obj P), l.edge.left.obj Q)
